scope: Post-shared-guard-fix protocol workload study; host model only

manifest.qualification: Observed compiled bindings; physical acceptance remains incomplete.

readiness.scope: Only this measured assembly/workload range; target latency/memory and unseen-device performance remain unqualified.

initial_preflight_abort.reason: A canonically reordered profile copy had a different wire CRC. Used preserved original bytes in capture-verified; settings/study/splits unchanged. No measured run was retried.

limitations: One assembly; four held-out workloads do not establish unseen-device or board accuracy.
Global faults enter labels; device fault attribution and measured SPI completion are unavailable.
Protocol target remains BMP388 sample freshness under mixed protocol load.
137 ms telemetry sampling can miss intermediate peaks; no visible-latency, utilization or energy claim.
800 ms goal is fixed; no generalization across freshness goals claimed.
